# Mati — mati.ad

> Mati's personal contact page. The page offers WhatsApp contact links in English, Spanish, Catalan, French and Portuguese.

## Contact

- [Canonical contact page](https://mati.ad/): The same five language options are visible on one static HTML page; no JavaScript is required.
- [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/376367071): Each language option on the contact page pre-fills a greeting in that language. The visitor reviews and sends the message; opening the link does not send it automatically.

## Languages

- English: Contact me.
- Español: Contáctame.
- Català: Contacta’m.
- Français: Contactez-moi.
- Português: Fala comigo.

## Site resources

- [Portrait](https://mati.ad/images/mati.png): Mati's portrait.
- [Sharing image](https://mati.ad/images/og-mati-square-v2.png): Square social preview.
- [Sitemap](https://mati.ad/sitemap.xml): Canonical public page.
- [Crawler policy](https://mati.ad/robots.txt): Search and AI-assisted retrieval policy.

https://www.mati.ad/ is an alternate hostname for the same page. https://mati.ad/ is the canonical URL.
